topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, context, and structural framing.

topics.label: Complement fundamentals, nomenclature, and C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core functions of complement, explain historical naming conventions, and describe the central role and cleavage of C3.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and explain how local convertase accumulation reaches the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the primary downstream effector functions executed by activated complement components.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how genetic and acquired deficiencies across different complement components manifest as distinct clinical disorders.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and biomedical applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how pathogens circumvent complement immunity and how bacterial evasion factors are utilized in research and clinical settings.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture session and previews the subsequent topic in the course.
